text: RESOLVED: a fixed core plan vocabulary (detection, estimation, AOI definition, comparison, pairing) plus a TYPED extension registry. NodeDef[P] carries a NodeId, a Codec[P] and an interpreter P => Op; registration is compile-time typed and only LOOKUP is by identifier, with a miss returning an explicit error naming the node and version. Rationale: covering the whole API means maintaining two parallel libraries by hand; covering only the core leaves a method developer's new measure invisible to the app until the library changes. The registry gets both -- but ONLY if entries stay typed. HOLD THE RULE from the PRD Product Warning: node parameters are typed domain values, never Map[String,String]; an inexpressible operation is a missing node, not a reason to add a dynamic one. New bead: pl-registry.
